annual.description: Chronological hourly intervals from Jan 1 00:00; length must equal hours in the recorded year, with no DST. Never remap to another year.

source_context.description: Optional original schedule provenance, seed/weather/calendar context and rule metadata. Not simulation operands; preserve unknowns.

evidence.description: One evidence row (ADR 0054 section 2), the same in every family: the source project and pinned revision, the locator in the file (`<path>#<locator>`) and the file's SHA-256 (null for an atlas record or decision with no file), the original value and unit, the transformation, the extraction date and the interpretation.

heat_fractions.description: For power loads only. Convective fraction = 1 - sum(all five fields). The sum must not exceed 1; known fractions are never overwritten.

applies_with.description: Construction-context conditions under which the load applies, e.g. {"foundation": "heated-basement"}.

host_zone.description: The source zone hosting the load inside the dwelling (living, garage, attic, crawlspace, basement, breezeway, ...).

role.description: A load with a special meaning, e.g. reference_design_adjustment.

schedule_id_by_climate.description: Schedules for the climate zones where a mix's trajectory differs from `schedule_id`; each is in `schedules`.

status.description: known: the source value (a source zero included); unknown: the source does not give it (value null, with its reason); filled: a stored filling (filled version only).

value_by_climate.description: Values for the climate zones where the source differs from `value` (ADR 0040, plan C6).

rule.description: Dates are inclusive recurring MM-DD boundaries; start > end wraps New Year. One value is constant; 24 values describe hourly intervals [h,h+1). Array order is authoritative.

source_context.description: Optional original schedule provenance, seed/weather/calendar context and rule metadata. Not simulation operands; preserve unknowns.

water_delivery_policy.description: Explicit user-approved source outlet cap. Preserve requested target schedules and report unmet target separately from delivered heat/fuel.

alternates.description: Second backed values where two sources disagree; the primary value is unchanged.

building_service_ids.description: Building services (building services 1.0.0) whose source objects sit in this program's zones.

dwelling.description: The dwelling the program describes. Loads keep the source basis, per dwelling unit where the source gives one; rooms, zones and systems are the consumer's (ADR 0038).

excluded_source_spaces.description: Source spaces of this space type that another program represents.

oneOf.description: Window over exterior wall area of the program zones by direction; roof is skylight over roof area. null: no exterior surface in that direction; 0: wall without window.

value_by_climate.description: Window ratios for the climate zones where the source differs (skylights in some zones).

oneOf.description: Window ratios of a dwelling that depend on its context (climate, foundation): each variant applies with its applies_with, as the dwelling's loads do.

lighting_controls.description: Lighting controls of the program (ADR 0044). `daylighting` null is a source zero: the complete source model has no daylighting controls in these zones. anyOf.description: The Daylighting:Controls of the source model zones the program represents (ADR 0044). The fractions are the source model values and are applied as given (release 2.0.0, ADR 0046 section 6); the settings are those of the zone with the most lighting power.

settings_conflict.description: Zones of the program differ in their settings.

kind.description: prototype_zone_set: geometry-derived from the Daylighting:Controls of the PNNL prototype zones the program was extracted from: the floor fraction of those zones with controls and the reference-point fractions weighted by zone lighting power, for the prototype geometry; reference_model_scan: no DOE Commercial Reference Building model has Daylighting:Controls (every IDF scanned): a source zero, independent of geometry and climate.

standards_rule.description: The openstudio-standards space-type daylighting inputs (90.1 templates).

anyOf.description: The PNNL prototype rule (an EMS program per zone, ADR 0060 section 1): at every timestep, in each controlled zone, while the condition holds and the zone lighting power per floor area is at least the threshold, the zone's lighting power is set to the cap; otherwise the scheduled lighting applies.

action.description: The zone's general Lights object is set to the cap.

additional_lighting_when_capped_W_m2.description: Where present, the additional (display) lighting object is set to this while the cap acts (the strip mall stores: 0).

calling_point.description: The EnergyPlus EMS calling point of the programs.

cap_W_m2.description: The lighting power per zone floor area the zone is set to: 0.02 W/ft2 (0.2153 W/m2).

condition.description: zone_occupant_count_zero: the People Occupant Count of the zone's People object is 0. other_zone_occupant_count_zero: the count of the People object of `condition_zone` is 0 (the warehouse storage zones read the office's).

condition_zone.description: The source zone whose occupant count the rule reads.

controlled_zones.description: Of them, the zones with the rule.

lighting_threshold_W_m2.description: The rule acts only while the zone lighting power (every Lights object of the zone) per floor area is at least this: 0.02 W/ft2 as the program converts it (x 0.093), 0.2151 W/m2.

description: Release 2.4.0 export (ADR 0061). 6.1.0 adds lighting_controls.unoccupied_lighting_cap: the unoccupied lighting cap rule of the source model zones, or null where they have none, with its evidence. Every 6.0.0 field keeps its meaning. Release 2.3.0 export (ADR 0054). version "source" holds actual values only; version "filled" applies the stored fillings and the exporter defaults with draw-only water heating. 6.0.0 changes from 5.4.0: evidence rows take the shape constructions use, with an id, and the document holds every row it cites; loads carry status, reason, filling and evidence_id; nulls gives the meaning of every null; dwelling window ratios that depend on context are fenestration.variants; lighting_controls.daylighting_origin labels where the daylighting fractions come from. Every other 5.4.0 field keeps its meaning.
title: Self-contained program JSON 6.1.0
